findings.title: KeyError crash when Integration metadata has no sender
findings.body: In src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py GitHubInstallation.dispatch does pipeline.fetch_state("github_authenticated_user") != integration.metadata["sender"]["login"]. If the Integration was created before sender tracking, via the normal pipeline without a webhook, or metadata lacks sender, this raises KeyError/TypeError resulting in a 500 instead of the intended github-integration-failed.html error page. It is a denial-of-service and breaks reinstall of legacy integrations.

findings.title: Fresh installs skip GitHub-user ownership check
findings.body: In src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py GitHubInstallation.dispatch returns pipeline.next_step() immediately when Integration.DoesNotExist for the supplied installation_id, without comparing github_authenticated_user to the installer. The sender comparison on lines 501-505 only runs when an Integration row already exists (e.g. created by webhook). A fresh installation_id with no row yet therefore creates an Integration without proving the Sentry user is the GitHub user who installed the app, defeating the PR's stated mismatch protection and depending on a webhook race.

findings.title: Unhandled token-exchange / user-info failures give 500 not error page
findings.body: In src/sentry/integrations/github/integration.py OAuthLoginView.dispatch calls safe_urlopen for the OAuth access_token exchange and get_user_info(payload["access_token"]) without try/except. Network errors, non-2xx, or GitHub ApiError from /user will propagate as an unhandled exception (500) instead of the intended Invalid installation request error page described in the PR. Only the missing-access_token and missing-login cases are handled.

findings.title: installation-not-found 404 path no longer tested
findings.body: In tests/sentry/integrations/github/test_integration.py test_installation_not_found stubs a 404 for /app/installations/{id} but then drives the new OAuthLoginView with code/state ddd023d87a913d5226e2a882c4c4cc05 that mismatches pipeline.signature, so it asserts b"Invalid installation request." from the state check and never exercises build_integration's 404 handling ("The GitHub installation could not be found."). The 404 branch is now uncovered.
